name: Derived maintenance family inconsistency (BoKS vs FIM)
expected: All maintenance families derive consistently: maint NetUnitPrice = tier x list. BoKS PIA-PIA-RNM-PIAMBK = 0.20 x 355 = 71 (carries Maintenance Type Defn=Standard). FIM new-maintenance should likewise resolve a tier x list net; if no Maintenance Type, the fallback should be a DOCUMENTED standard (e.g. Standard 20% => 0.20 x 2008 = 401.60), not variable 100%-copy or $0.
actual: BoKS PASSES: PIA-PIA-RNM-PIAMBK QLIA Maintenance Type Defn=Standard -> tier 0.20 -> NetUnitPrice=71 (Source_List_Price=355), stable through a fresh active-V21 Force-reprice (isSuccess:true). FIM FAILS the consistency rule: FIM-FIM-RNM-CCMLSE / CCMMSN ProductAttributeDefinitions carry only Feature Options / Unit Type / Number of Units -> NO Maintenance Type Defn (MTD); their QLIAs confirm no MTD. On live quote 0Q0WC000003AqV30AK the FIM maint lines net VARIABLY: CCMLSE=2008 (100% of the 2008 license list, native Formula=UnitPrice copy, NOT 0.20x2008=401.60); two duplicate CCMLSE lines net $0/null; CCMMSN nets $0 (Source_List_Price=34750, net=0). Scope: of 3,394 maintenance products only ~183 carry MTD (PIA 2, GS 141, FIM only 1 = FIM-FIM-RNM-TEMSSU); the entire FIM CCM family is among the ~3,200 missing MTD.
evidence: BoKS control (PASS): https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003FKRJ0A4/view -- QLI 0QLWC000003kUpO4AU NetUnitPrice=71, Source_List_Price=355; QLIA 0zuWC0000068sUUYAY (Maintenance Type Defn=Standard, IsPriceImpacting=true); ProductAttributeDefinition 0v7WC0000000EjZYAU (PIAMBK -> MTD). FIM inconsistency: https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003AqV30AK/view -- QLI 0QLWC000003g4YX4AY CCMLSE NetUnitPrice=2008 (100%); 0QLWC000003g4YZ4AY / 0QLWC000003g4Ya4AI CCMLSE net 0/null; 0QLWC000003g4QT4AY CCMMSN net 0. ProductAttributeDefinition: CCMLSE/CCMMSN carry FO/UNT/NU only, no MTD (0v7WC0000000ECgYAM..ECqYAM). QLIAs on g4QT/g4YX/g4Ya confirm no Maintenance Type Defn. Maintenance_Rate__mdt = 7 tiers (Standard 0.20). V21 reprice marker: connect/rev/sales-transaction/actions/place isSuccess:true on 0Q0WC000003FKRJ0A4.
defectStep: V21 step 39 'Derived Pricing Formula' (tier lookup on Maintenance Type AttributeValue; missing attr -> tier=0) + step 41 'Derived Products - Native Pull' (native Formula=UnitPrice 100%-copy fallback). No procedure-level documented safe-default tier.
proposedFix: Two-part, both owner/config (NOT V21 logic-on-reprice): (1) DATA -- add the Maintenance Type Defn (MTD) attribute + value to the ~3,200 maintenance products that lack it (Fortra-supplied Maintenance-Type data; FIM CCM family especially), so the tier lookup resolves. (2) PROCEDURE SAFE-DEFAULT (design, optional) -- in step 39 Derived Pricing Formula, replace the bare 'else 0' with a documented standard default (e.g. Standard 0.20) so a missing-MTD line yields a predictable 20% net rather than variable native 100%-copy or $0. Until (1)/(2), DPP is correctly scoped to BoKS only (Nir).
notes: Config/parity scenario per METHOD_BRIEF (derived-family inconsistency = no-DML-fixture; validated by querying existing real records + proc metadata). Both quotes are real UI-built records (not headless Apex-inserted), so the headless base-seed $0 trap does NOT apply -- the FIM $0/100% nets are genuine catalog-config outputs, and the BoKS positive control prices correctly through the SAME V21 derived branch, isolating the cause to the missing MTD attribute on FIM products + no safe-default in step 39. Active proc = Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure V21 (confirmed Active 2026-06-29). Matches documented memory project_newmaint_derivation_inconsistency + project_derived_pricing_demo_recipe (BoKS works because it HAS Maintenance Type Defn; FIM 'wrong bundle format' per Nir). Reportable as ORG-CONFIG-DEFECT: a real sales rep building a FIM maintenance quote in the UI WOULD hit the same 100%-copy/$0 gap.
verdict_reason: BoKS maintenance derives correctly (0.20x355=71, MTD=Standard present) but FIM maintenance is inconsistent on real data -- no Maintenance Type Defn attribute -> native fallback yields variable 100%-copy (CCMLSE=2008) or $0 (CCMMSN), not a documented standard rate, reproduced on live UI-built quote 0Q0WC000003AqV30AK.
